{{Quote|What? Lieutenant Torsin, is that you? Blast it, Nalto, get me a clear visual!|Captain Ardmore|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ardmore''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Captain Ardmore tasked one of his subordinates, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Torsin]], with leading a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] to reclaim the [[Stillwater Farms]] in the [[Gorinth Agricultural Sector]], and the unit carried a set of [[RK-9 soil devastator]]s as a last resort. When Torsin's unit was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Balmorran resistance]], Ardmore had his subordinate Lieutenant [[Nalto]] continue to try and contact Torsin, and when Imperial forces came upon their bodies, Ardmore asked them to destroy the farms with the soil devastators.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ardmore appears in hologram form in conversations for the mission "Salting the Fields" for Imperial players in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
